title: 1. Harmony is diversity in wholeness
md:
**Clarified idea.** Harmony is *diversity kept within a whole, where the parts and the whole strengthen each other*. The parts could refuse, and they flourish. Rank is allowed; sacrifice of a part to the whole is not. Dissonance belongs inside harmony and is not its opposite. The opposite of harmony is disintegration, which takes two forms:

- **homogenization**: a whole with no diversity left (unison, lock, monoculture);
- **fragmentation**: diversity with no whole (noise).

Ratios, consonance and mode-locking are one way harmony happens. They are not its definition.



## Grounding

- Philolaus: harmony is needed only because things are unlike. Like things "had no need of harmony" [[1]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-philolaus-unlike-need-harmony).
- Heraclitus: "concordant and discordant … from all things one" [[2]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-heraclitus-couplings).
- *De Mundo*: nature makes concord "from opposites … not from like things" [[3]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-demundo-opposites-not-like). Its political example is a city of poor and rich, young and old [[4]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-demundo-political-harmony).
- Aristotle's report of the Pythagorean table of opposites [[5]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-aristotle-table-of-opposites), which Lomas & Xue extend across cultures [[6]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/lomas#lomas-opposites-table). "Not the middle ground but the strength of both parts" [[7]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/lomas#lomas-opposites-strength-of-both).
- The Chinese tradition draws the same line as Philolaus, independently, with *he* 和 against *tong* 同. Yanzi says harmony is a soup made of contrasting ingredients [[8]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-zuozhuan-he-like-soup), while sameness is "water added to water" or a single zither note [[9]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-zuozhuan-tong-water-with-water). Shi Bo says "harmony begets things; sameness does not continue" [[10]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-guoyu-he-begets-tong-fails). In the Analects, the junzi is "harmonious but not the same" [[11]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-analects-he-bu-tong). Two cautions from the author studies: that reading of 13.23 comes to us through Zhu Xi, for whom *he* lies inside ritual and means due measure [[12]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-zhuxi-he-unforced-within-li), [[13]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-zhuxi-zhonghe-no-discord); and Xunzi praises *tong* outright: "music unites the same" [[14]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-xunzi-music-unites-same-ritual-separates). Yanzi and Shi Bo are the strong Chinese witnesses, not the Confucian line as a whole.
- Alberti defines beauty as a "consensus" of parts according to number [[15]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-alberti-beauty-consensus-of-parts).
- Ecology offers a measurable case. In a decade-long grassland experiment, diverse plots kept their productivity more stable [[16]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-tilman-2006-diversity-stability). One explanation is insurance: species fluctuate out of step with each other [[17]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-insurance-hypothesis).
- Formal versions of "variety × unity": Hutcheson's "compound Ratio of Uniformity and Variety" (1725) [[18]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-hutcheson-compound-ratio), formalised as a product in [[19]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/proposals#prop-leibniz-product) (the id is historical: Leibniz's own line is only variety "along with" order [[20]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-leibniz-variety-order)); Fechner's unity through a manifold, with an optimum rather than a monotone rise [[21]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-fechner-unity-through-manifold); Tononi–Sporns–Edelman complexity, which is high only when segregation and integration coexist [[22]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/neuro#neuro-complexity-segregation-integration); Simon's near-decomposability [[23]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-simon-near-decomposability).

## What the author studies changed (2026-10-22)

The 105 author pages and the census of 3,933 defining sentences were read against this page. Four results.

**1. The definition has a real lineage, but it is a minority one.** In the census only 15% of historical definitions fall in the diversity/opposites family, against 32% for ratio/consonance, and the share is flat from the 9th century to the 20th [[24]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-census-diversity-family-minority). Outside Chinese, half of those diversity definitions are also ratio definitions: Boethius's "concord of dissimilar sounds reduced into one" is the type [[25]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-census-diversity-inside-ratio), [[26]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-boethius-consonance-dissimilar-into-one). The strongest support, read in the texts:

- Zarlino: harmony "arises from nothing other than the diversity of things that are put together and are opposite to one another" [[27]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-zarlino-harmony-from-diversity), and consonance alone would be "imperfect" [[28]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-zarlino-dissonance-sweetens).
- Plotinus: the whole is beautiful not "as a stone" but when each unequal voice gives its own tone [[29]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-plotinus-whole-harmony-unequal-voices).
- Pseudo-Plutarch's Aristotle: "unequal parts that nevertheless harmonize" [[30]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-pseudo-plutarch-aristotle-unequal-parts).
- Cusanus, Pico and Bruno: "order, harmony, and proportion in diversity" [[31]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#mus-cusa-singularity-harmony-in-diversity); a "discordant concord" [[32]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-pico-worlds-discordant-concord); concord "only where there is contrariety" [[33]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-bruno-all-from-contraries-vicissitude).
- Fechner names *both* of this page's opposites: one judges a case "by the feeling of monotony or fragmentation" [[34]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-fechner-monotony-or-fragmentation).
- Goethe on colour, below; Wang Zhi on Zhang Zai, who names both failure modes in Chinese: similar but cannot differ, differs but cannot be similar [[35]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-zhengmeng-chuyi-same-and-different).

**2. "Found in all cultures" is not earned in the strong form.** Thirty-five non-Western texts were read for their native terms. The two failure modes are found widely, fragmentation and faction above all. Diversity kept *inside* the whole as a good is rare: Yanzi and Shi Bo, Zeami's yin and yang, Zhang Zai in part, Caraka's tripod, and Philo, who is Greek philosophy carried over. The dominant senses are the mean or due measure [[36]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-census-he-due-measure-dominant), [[37]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-asian-sona-evenness-is-the-mean), order and rank [[38]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-asian-raga-polity-rank), union and likeness [[39]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-asian-upanishad-unity-erases-parts), and the absence of contention [[40]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-zuozhuan-harmony-ends-contention). Several equivalences we took as given are the 19th-century translators' word, not the source's: Legge renders Analects 1.12's 和 as "a natural ease", and the Soṇa simile's "harmony" is not in the Pali. This supports [[41]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-perennialism-rhetoric). The claim that survives is weaker and still interesting: *the failure modes are near-universal; the positive ideal of kept diversity was reached independently at least twice* (Philolaus and Yanzi).

**3. There are counter-texts, and they are definitions, not misunderstandings.**

- *Unison is the best harmony.* Mersenne counts the unison the "exemplary cause and end" of all consonances, calls pleasure in diversity a sign of "our neediness and our imperfection", and diversity "the source of corruption" in a republic [[42]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-mersenne-unison-sweetest), [[43]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-mersenne-diversity-is-imperfection), [[44]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-mersenne-unison-communion). Maier makes the homogeneous the measure of the unequal [[45]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-maier-unison-rule-homogeneous-gold), [[46]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-maier-harmony-like-rejoices-in-like).
- *Like follows like.* Dong Zhongshu: all things "leave what is unlike and follow what is like" [[47]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-dong-zhongshu-like-follows-like). That is the exact inverse of Philolaus, and it is a theory of *resonance* (idea 12).
- *A whole needs one element to dominate.* Ibn Khaldūn: a mixture whose elements neutralise each other cannot form a temperament [[48]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-khaldun-asabiyya-like-temperament). The rāga polity says the same in music: the vādī is king and the vivādī the enemy [[49]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-sangitaratnakara-vadi-king-vivadi-enemy).
- *The whole licenses the parts' destruction.* Campanella: from the whole's point of view everything, including the parts' deaths, is harmony [[50]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-campanella-harmony-relative-to-parts), [[51]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-campanella-parts-die-for-whole). Plotinus places parts in Tartarus for the whole's beauty, and Eriugena finds the lashed slave in harmony with the royal house [[52]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-eriugena-punishment-in-harmony), [[53]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#anc-eriugena-royal-house-harmony).
- *Harmony is a cage.* In the Hermetica *harmonia* is the planetary order the soul is enslaved in and stripped of on the way up [[54]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-hermetica-man-enslaved-in-harmony), [[55]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-hermetica-ascent-gives-back-harmony). The one Hermetic line that fits this page is about *amicitia*, friendship of opposites, which SL's English renders "harmony" [[56]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-hermetica-friendship-of-opposites-light). Do not quote it as harmony.

**4. The commonest failure among supporters is diversity resolved, not kept.** Theon's Pythagoreans define music as "a harmony of opposites, a unification of the many", with the goal of like-mindedness [[57]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-theon-music-harmony-of-opposites), [[58]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-theon-unification-of-the-many). Eriugena's restored universe sounds "without any dissonance"; Giorgi lays dissonant matter aside [[59]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-giorgi-dissonant-matter-laid-aside); Cusanus's *una religio in rituum varietate* is a step toward "one orthodox faith" [[60]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-cusa-diversity-reduced-to-one-faith); Postel tolerates rites "until" [[61]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-postel-rites-tolerated-until); Comenius wants "the same perceptions regarding the same things" [[62]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-comenius-concord-needs-consensus). On the page, these authors are cited for this definition; in the text, most of them end in homogenization. Aristotle is the clean opposite: making concord into unison destroys it [[63]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-aristotle-harmony-into-unison), though he still ranks the octave first [[64]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-aristotle-problems-consonance-over-unison).

### The perfection school and Kant's break

The closest 18th-century wording of this definition is Wolff's: *perfectio est consensus in varietate*, "perfection is agreement in variety" [[65]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-wolff-perfection-consensus-in-varietate), in German "die Zusammenstimmung des Mannigfaltigen" [[66]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-wolff-dm152-zusammenstimmung). Wolff keeps the parts plural: each has perfections of its own [[67]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-wolff-parts-own-perfection), and a part's defect can belong to the whole's perfection [[68]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-wolff-part-imperfection-belongs-to-whole). But "agreement" means tending to one end, and the whole's end fixes the parts [[69]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-wolff-whole-determines-parts). Variety is kept, never valued for itself. Hutcheson reached "uniformity amidst variety" in the same decades, apparently independently (`ideas/schools.md`).

Kant's answer (KU §15) matters for this page. He keeps Wolff's phrase, harmony of the manifold into one, but cuts it from perfection: beauty is formal fit with no concept of what the thing is *for* [[70]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-kant-ku15-formal-harmony-of-manifold-no-perfection), [[71]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-kant-ku16-free-beauty-presupposes-no-perfection). "The parts and the whole strengthen each other" presupposes a function for each, so it is a perfection claim in Wolff's sense. The definition either needs a purpose-free reading of "strengthen" (persistence, as the Tilman memo proposes), or it inherits Kant's objection and should say so.

### Darwin and Wallace: fit, and divergence

Wallace's "harmony" is fit between an organism and its surroundings: health "results [from] a harmony between the individual and the universe that surrounds it", and selection restores that harmony when conditions change [[72]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-wallace-1864-harmony-individual-universe), [[73]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-wallace-1864-selection-restores-harmony). In man the mind keeps it [[74]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-wallace-1864-mind-keeps-harmony). That is a sixth rival sense, harmony as adaptation. In *Contributions* (1870) he widens it to the whole of life: "an unbroken and harmonious system" [[75]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-wallace-1855-unbroken-harmonious-system), kept "in harmony with the inorganic, and with itself" [[76]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-wallace-1867-harmony-with-itself), with forms that adjust "to each other and to surrounding nature" [[77]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-wallace-1868-equilibrium-harmony-self-regulating). That is a whole of unlike parts, but held by selection and equilibrium; he never says the diversity is what makes it harmonious [[78]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-wallace-harmony-is-fit-not-diversity). Darwin's "harmonious diversity" is a closing phrase [[79]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-darwin-1859-harmonious-diversity); his real contribution is divergence, by which more varied forms let more life live in one place [[80]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-darwin-1859-diversification-supports-more). That is the nearest Victorian biology comes to this page, but the mechanism is rivalry and he never says the parts fit each other [[81]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-darwin-harmonious-diversity-is-niche-diversity). "Survival of the harmonised" stays Lin & Lomas's phrase [[82]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-survival-of-harmonised-not-wallace). Wallace's other image is a governor, a feedback that corrects deficiency before it shows [[83]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-wallace-1858-governor-feedback): stability, not diversity. In *Descent* Darwin's nearest thing to social harmony is sympathy, an instinct [[84]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#eco-darwin-descent-sympathy-instinct) that widens to "men of all races ... and finally to the lower animals" [[85]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#eco-darwin-descent-sympathy-widens). That is a whole taking in more unlike members, which this page could use, but Darwin does not call it harmony.

### Seven authors from the Lomas papers' citations (2026-10-23)

These are the thinkers the Lomas papers cite most that had no author page.
- **Heraclitus is the strongest support anywhere in the KB.** "The unlike is joined together, and from differences results the most beautiful harmony" [[86]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-heraclitus-differences-most-beautiful-harmony). The harmony of the world is "a harmony of oppositions, as in the case of the bow and of the lyre" [[87]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-heraclitus-harmony-of-oppositions-bow-lyre). "The hidden harmony is better than the visible" [[88]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-heraclitus-hidden-harmony-better). Plutarch adds that without strife there could be no harmony "without sharps and flats" [[89]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-heraclitus-plutarch-no-harmony-without-sharps-flats), which is the guard clause's "dissonance is part of harmony". Two cautions. Two of these come through Aristotle and Plutarch in Patrick's English. And Schuster reads the hidden-harmony line as a question [[90]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-heraclitus-schuster-hidden-harmony-as-question).
- **The *Daodejing* leans toward support.** Opposites "give birth to one another" and notes "harmonise" through their relation (ch. 2) [[91]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-laozi-ch2-notes-harmonious-through-relation). All things "are harmonised by the Breath of Vacancy" (ch. 42) [[92]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-laozi-ch42-harmonised-by-breath). But a commentator in the 1740 anthology glosses 和 as "union", which is one [[93]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-laozi-lu-commentary-harmony-is-union). That is the same "resolved, not kept" pull as Zhu Xi.
- **Humboldt is the nearest modern statement.** He defines nature as "unity in multiplicity" (*Einheit in der Vielheit*) [[94]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-humboldt-1845-unity-in-multiplicity). In free nature one feels "the dim feeling of harmony" (*Einklang*) [[95]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-humboldt-1845-dim-feeling-of-harmony). But his higher intelligence "resolves diversity into unity" [[96]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-humboldt-1845-diversity-resolved-into-unity): resolved again.
- **Vitruvius gives partial support.** Eurythmy and symmetry are part answering to whole [[97]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-vitruvius-eurythmy-symmetry-defined), and the theatre's tuned vessels give the voice "a concordant harmony" [[98]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-vitruvius-theatre-vessels-concordant-harmony). Otherwise he uses *harmonia* only as the name of a genus.
- **Spinoza is the sharpest counter-text after Mersenne.** He lists "harmony" among the names imagination gives to what pleases the ears. He mocks the belief that God delights in it [[99]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-spinoza-harmony-is-imagination), and says concord can be bought by fear or flattery [[100]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-spinoza-concord-by-fear-and-flattery). His positive word is agreement (*convenientia*). Only what agrees with our nature is good [[101]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-spinoza-good-only-insofar-as-agrees-with-our-nature). Men agree only under reason, not passion [[102]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-spinoza-passions-disagree-reason-agree). Yet the body is "composed of a great many parts of different natures" [[103]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-spinoza-corporeal-composition-different-natures). So diversity in a whole survives, without the word.
- **Smith** puts harmony between two people. The sufferer must bring his feeling into "compleat harmony and concord" with the spectator's [[104]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-smith-1759-harmony-concord-sufferer), and sympathy "keeps time" [[105]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-smith-1759-keep-perfect-time). The harmony needs both sides to adjust, not one to copy the other: see [[106]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-smith-sympathy-is-imagined-not-automatic) against the Enigma paper.
- **Kropotkin does not support.** He refuses Rousseau's nature of "love, peace, and harmony" as firmly as Huxley's war of all against all [[107]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-kropotkin-1918-neither-rousseau-nor-huxley). Mutual aid outweighs struggle [[108]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-kropotkin-1918-mutual-aid-factor-of-evolution), but he keeps both.

Net: one strong support (Heraclitus), four partial, one counter-text and one no. The recurring pattern stands. Most sources praise variety, then let the whole resolve it.

### Byzantium, the commentators, Tibet (2026-10-23)

- **Byzantium supplies the strongest formula.** Metochites: the constitution is "a kind of harmony" built from different types, and equal honour for all, like strings of equal tension, is "most inharmonious" [[109]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-metochites-state-harmony-of-different-types), [[110]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-metochites-unison-is-disharmony). Gregory of Nyssa, centuries earlier: if the sound were uniform the melody would not be composed [[111]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-nyssa-cosmos-harmony-uniform-sound-no-melody). The Suda defines harmony as "the union of things mixed and of those who think differently" [[112]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-suda-harmony-union-of-the-differently-minded). The new element is Chalcedonian. Things are gathered "without confusion" and held "without division" [[113]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-dionysius-peace-gathers-without-confusion), and the church makes an "unconfused union" among the differences of beings [[114]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-maximus-church-unconfused-union-of-the-different). A blend is a co-breathing (σύμπνοια) that keeps the natures, not a kneading that destroys them [[115]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-pachymeres-opposites-led-to-harmony-by-simple-elements). That is the clearest "kept, not resolved" in the KB. Its price is rank: Metochites ties harmony to grades [[116]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-metochites-no-harmony-without-grades), and Nyssa's chorus has one leader [[117]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-nyssa-fall-dissolved-the-choral-consonance). Plethon splits the work between two gods: Apollo of the Same gathers into one harmony, Artemis of the Other distinguishes [[118]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-plethon-many-parted-whole-one-harmony), [[119]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-plethon-artemis-other-distinguishes). Llull: concordance "cannot exist without plurality" [[120]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-llull-concordance-needs-plurality).
- **The Chinese commentators mostly keep the difference.** Lü Nan and Lin Li read 和而不同 as the Yijing's 同而異, "the same yet different" [[121]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-lunan-he-er-butong-is-tong-er-yi), [[122]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-linli-tong-er-yi-is-he-er-butong). Chen Xiangdao: 和 has difference without clash [[123]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-chen-xiangdao-he-has-difference-without-clash). Hu Zhen is the exception, with 和 as one body [[124]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-huzhen-he-sees-all-as-one-body). Laozi's commentator likewise reads 和 as 合, "union" (authors/laozi.md).
- **Tibet adds two tests.** The sangha's harmony is one rule and one recitation, "like water and milk mixed" [[125]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-vinaya-harmonious-community-water-milk). But the commentary reads the milk as tolerating one another's words [[126]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-vinaya-commentary-water-milk-is-tolerance), and the schismatic is the one who says "this alone is the truth" [[127]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-devadatta-exclusive-truth-is-the-schism). Concord of practice, with the persons left many. In the tantras, "one taste" is not sameness: the pig and the elephant stay distinct [[128]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-equal-taste-not-sameness-pig-and-elephant), and the many are realised as one and the one arises as many [[129]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-mahamudra-many-as-one-taste-one-taste-as-many). Drukpa Kunley's realised person is "in harmony with all" yet does not hand over their own power [[130]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-kunley-in-harmony-with-all-yet-keeps-own-power). That is a near statement of the guard clause.
- **Counter-text:** the Arabic *Theology of Aristotle* makes harmony an accident of mixture that needs a harmonizer [[131]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-theology-aristotle-strings-need-a-musician): the whole precedes the diversity.

### Lipps, Spencer, Wallace in *Light* (2026-10-24)

- **Lipps** makes harmony a fit of unlike rhythms. The ratios of the tone-rhythms "make harmony and disharmony" [[132]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-lipps-1885-rhythm-ratios-make-harmony), and a sound is one ground-rhythm differentiated differently in each tone [[133]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-lipps-1905-one-ground-rhythm-differentiated). Several melodies make a unity only if one rules [[134]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-lipps-1903-voices-one-ruling). That is rank allowed, as the guard clause has it, but nothing in Lipps says a voice could refuse: partial support.
- **Wallace in 1885** argues that in "a perfect and harmonious world" perfect beings could have been created but not evolved [[135]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-wallace-1885-perfect-harmonious-world-no-evolution), and closes on Pope: "All Discord, Harmony not understood" [[136]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-wallace-1885-all-discord-harmony-not-understood). Discord inside harmony, as this page holds, but as theodicy: the discord is only apparent.

### Colour: Goethe against Schloss and Palmer

Goethe's *harmonic* colour pairs are complementaries forming a "satisfying wholeness" [[137]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-goethe-harmony-is-totality). Neighbouring hues, the pairs Schloss and Palmer's raters judge *most* harmonious [[138]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-colour-harmony-rises-with-hue-similarity), he calls "characterless": too close "for their impression to become significant", though "not bad" [[139]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-goethe-neighbours-characterless). He also has his own guard clause: a total harmony with all colours in equilibrium is itself characterless [[140]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-goethe-totality-without-character). So the 1810 theorist and the 2011 raters use the word for two things, completion against ease. That supports reading B of the colour memo (two senses, `critique/definition-pressure-2026-10.md`) as the honest position, with C (similarity as the integration term) still the one that predicts something.

## The definition: decided 2026-10-23

The recommendation below was adopted on 2026-10-23. The sentence went from *diversity in wholeness, where the parts and the whole strengthen each other* to *diversity kept within a whole, where the parts and the whole strengthen each other*, and the guard clause gained refusal and rank-without-sacrifice. Consequences of A: the definition is presented as a proposal with a minority lineage, so any "found in all cultures" sentence in the Lomas papers and on sourcelibrary.org has to go or be weakened to "found, in this form, in several traditions" (Heraclitus, Yanzi/Shi Bo, Metochites, the Analects commentators, Maximus).

Later evidence for the choice: "kept" is the Chalcedonian "without confusion, without division" [[113]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-dionysius-peace-gathers-without-confusion), [[114]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-maximus-church-unconfused-union-of-the-different) and the commentators' 同而異 [[121]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-lunan-he-er-butong-is-tong-er-yi); "could refuse" is Drukpa Kunley's realised person, "in harmony with all" yet keeping their own power [[130]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-kunley-in-harmony-with-all-yet-keeps-own-power), and the Vinaya's schismatic, who insists "this alone is the truth" [[127]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-devadatta-exclusive-truth-is-the-schism); "rank allowed" is Metochites's graded constitution [[116]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-metochites-no-harmony-without-grades).

The four options as they were put:

- **A. Keep it, change the claim around it.** Present the definition as a proposal with a minority lineage (15% of historical definitions; two independent origins), not as a summary of what cultures mean by the word. *Cost:* none to the theory; every "found in all cultures" sentence in the papers and on the public page has to go.
- **B. Say "kept".** *Harmony is diversity kept within a whole, where the parts and the whole strengthen each other.* This one word separates the definition from Theon, Eriugena, Cusanus and Comenius, who are otherwise its main historical witnesses and who resolve diversity into one. It also ties idea 1 to idea 2: resolution into one is lock.
- **C. Put refusal in the guard clause.** "The parts flourish, and the parts could refuse." Campanella, Plotinus's Tartarus, Eriugena's slave and Carey's slaves all pass "diversity in wholeness" and fail this. It is also the colour memo's Rosa recommendation.
- **D. Allow rank, forbid sacrifice.** Ibn Khaldūn, the rāga polity and Rameau's fundamental bass are wholes with a dominant part. The definition does not have to exclude hierarchy; it has to exclude a whole that is bought with a part. Say so, or the definition will be read as egalitarian, which the musical evidence (a tonic, a vādī) does not support.

**Recommendation:** A and B in the sentence, C and D in the guard clause. The sentence becomes *harmony is diversity kept within a whole, where the parts and the whole strengthen each other*; the guard clause adds that the parts could refuse, and that rank is allowed where sacrifice is not. Mersenne and Dong Zhongshu are then named as the rival definition (harmony as likeness), with the reason given for rejecting it: idea 2, likeness under coupling ends in lock.

## The guard clause

As decided: *the parts flourish, the parts could refuse, and rank is allowed where sacrifice is not.*

"The parts flourish" is what separates harmony from mere wholeness [[141]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/proposals#prop-mutual-flourishing-term). "Could refuse" separates it from a whole held by force or by declaration: Campanella's city, Carey's slaves. "Rank without sacrifice" keeps the tonic and the vādī while excluding a whole bought with a part. Without it, the definition can be used to sacrifice the parts to the whole, or to censor in the name of "harmony" [[142]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-harmony-as-power). Never state the definition without the clause.

The economists show why. Bastiat used "harmony" to argue for free trade, Carey to argue for protection, and Fourier for his phalanstery [[143]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-econ-word-claimed-by-all). Carey went on to declare that slaves' interests were in harmony with their masters' [[144]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/economics#econ-carey-slave-master). A doctrine that declares interests harmonious, without testing whether both parties can refuse and both flourish, will cover domination [[145]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-econ-harmony-covers-domination). The *he*/*tong* distinction did not stop the same misuse in China [[146]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-asian-he-tong-conformity).

## Tensions and critiques

- If everything is diverse and whole, the definition explains nothing [[147]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-tautology). The answer is to measure harmony before the outcome it should predict (see idea 7).
- "Only a metaphor" [[148]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-aristotle-metaphor).
- Perennialist rhetoric: "found in all cultures" is a claim that needs evidence [[41]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-perennialism-rhetoric). The verdict above is that the strong form is not earned.
- Chinese philosophy has its own internal critique of harmony-talk [unverified].
- **Perceived colour harmony tracks similarity.** Observers rate colour pairs as more harmonious as their hues get *closer* [[138]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-colour-harmony-rises-with-hue-similarity). That runs against the definition at the perceptual level [[149]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-colour-harmony-tension). There are two possible readings. On one, a single pair of colours is the wrong level, and harmony in a whole composition needs contrast (idea 3). On the other, "harmony" as people use the word in perception means fit or ease, and the definition is stipulative there. Settle this before any paper claims the definition matches ordinary usage.
- **The whole is steady while the parts fluctuate.** In Tilman's grassland, diversity steadies the whole while individual species become *less* stable [[150]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-whole-stable-parts-fluctuate). Does that meet "the parts flourish"? Only if flourishing means persisting, not being steady.
- Ecology has no single diversity–stability law. The answer depends on what kind of stability is measured [[151]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-eco-stability-multifaceted) and on how the network is structured [[152]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-eco-may-vs-structure).

## Open questions

- What measure of degree works across levels?
- Fechner's optimum: is harmony a peak at middling diversity, not a product that rises with it? The census and Fechner both point to an interior optimum [[21]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-fechner-unity-through-manifold).
- Which test separates "kept" from "resolved"? A whole that converges to one state over time, versus one that keeps its parts distinct at equilibrium.
- Is "parts strengthened" measurable without importing a theory of the good?

**Related:** ideas 2 (lock), 3 (levels), 5 (ratios as one manifestation), 7 (research programme), 12 (resonance and harmony).

title: 2. Harmony is fit that keeps its tension; lock is fit without it
md:
**Clarified idea.** "Too much harmony" is a category mistake. What goes wrong is **lock, or fusion**: coupling so strong that the parts' differences collapse into sameness. This is a claim against a rival school, not a consensus: Mersenne, Dong Zhongshu and those who resolve diversity into one call that collapse harmony. Harmony stays just short of lock. That near-miss is what keeps systems alive, giving them cycles, sustain and character [[1]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/proposals#prop-harmony-vs-lock).



## Grounding

- **Slight mistuning sustains.** Coupled piano unison strings [[2]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-piano-unison-detuning) (status partial: the details of the two-stage decay are not in the abstract). Mildly dissonant chords are often preferred [[3]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-mild-dissonance-preferred).
- **Exact lock freezes.** The Moon's 1:1 spin-orbit lock, and Mercury's 3:2 [[4]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-tidal-lock-is-resonance). Near-resonance and chaos keep the solar system changing [[5]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-solar-system-chaos). The same ratio can hold or eject: Hildas versus the Kirkwood gaps [[6]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-orbital-resonance-two-faced).
- **Strong coupling collapses diversity.** Synchronization needs weak coupling, and strong coupling forces unison or quenches oscillation [[7]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-strong-coupling-unison). Unison (1:1) has the widest locking region, so it is the strongest attractor [[8]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-mode-locking-arnold). Between fragmentation and unison lies a band where diverse oscillators cohere [[9]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/proposals#prop-coupling-window) (a proposal, unverified). Resonance alone, like answering like, drives a population toward that attractor; harmony needs shared ratios plus enough heterogeneity and weak enough coupling to stop short of it [unverified] (a proposal, untested; see idea 12).
- **Brains.** Both too much and too little synchrony go with disorder [[10]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/neuro#neuro-sync-pathology-both-ways); the healthy state is a balance [[11]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/lomas#lomas-rp69-sync-balance).
- **Machines.** Smolensky's harmony maximization "freezes" as temperature falls [[12]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ai#ai-smolensky-harmonium). The remedy is a finite temperature (idea 8).
- **Inharmonicity as character.** Most vibrating bodies are inharmonic [[13]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-inharmonic-bodies). Cusanus makes the near-miss a matter of principle: exact equality belongs to God alone, so no two voices or bells are ever in precise proportion, and "proportion in equality" cannot be heard by a living person [[14]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-cusa-no-precise-harmony-in-sensibles).

### Unison as the failure of concord: the historical witnesses

The thesis has a long lineage, mostly verified on Source Library pages:

- **Aristotle**, against Plato's Republic: a city pressed toward too much unity stops being a city, "just as if someone were to make a concord (*symphonia*) into a unison (*homophonia*), or a rhythm into a single beat" [[15]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-aristotle-harmony-into-unison). In the *Problems*, every consonance is pleasanter than a single note [[16]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-aristotle-problems-consonance-over-unison).
- **Yanzi and Shi Bo**: sameness (同) is water added to water, a zither playing one note [[17]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-zuozhuan-tong-water-with-water); harmony begets things, sameness does not continue [[18]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-guoyu-he-begets-tong-fails). Legge renders 同 as "assent" [[19]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-legge-tong-as-assent).
- **The Chinese commentators** keep the difference inside the togetherness. Lü Nan equates 和而不同 with the Yijing's 同而異, "the same yet different" [[20]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-lunan-he-er-butong-is-tong-er-yi); Lin Li makes the same identification and resolves the two senses of 同 [[21]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-linli-tong-er-yi-is-he-er-butong), [[22]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-linli-two-senses-of-tong); Chen Xiangdao: 和 has difference without clash, 同 accord without difference [[23]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-chen-xiangdao-he-has-difference-without-clash). All four are partial (Chinese read from SL's OCR, English is our gloss).
- **Gregory of Nyssa**: the cosmos is a musical harmony that holds although its parts differ greatly; if the sound were uniform in all, no melody would exist [[24]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-nyssa-cosmos-harmony-uniform-sound-no-melody).
- **Metochites**, the sharpest statement: a lyre whose strings all have equal tension has no harmony, consonance or tune; the whole of unison is "disharmony" (ἀναρμοστία), and equality of honour in all things is the most "inharmonious" state [[25]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-metochites-unison-is-disharmony), [[26]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-metochites-state-harmony-of-different-types).
- **Pachymeres** on Dionysius: the blending of the orders is not a kneading that destroys the natures but a co-breathing (σύμπνοια) that keeps even opposites at peace [[27]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-pachymeres-opposites-led-to-harmony-by-simple-elements); Dionysius's harmony is "gathered without confusion" [[28]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-dionysius-peace-gathers-without-confusion). Fusion is the Byzantine name for lock.
- **Tibet**: in "one taste" water poured into water, yet "look at the pig and the elephant; they are not the same" [[29]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-equal-taste-not-sameness-pig-and-elephant); one taste runs both ways, many into one and one into many [[30]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-mahamudra-many-as-one-taste-one-taste-as-many). A Vinaya commentary reads the harmonious community's "water and milk" as mutual tolerance of speech, not identity of persons [[31]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-vinaya-commentary-water-milk-is-tolerance).

### Lock by force: social concord without tension

Spinoza: concord is often produced by fear, and then lacks trust; flattery also produces it, "through the foul crime of servitude" [[32]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-spinoza-concord-by-fear-and-flattery) (his word is *concordia*). This is the social form of lock: the fit is held by a coupling too strong for the parts to refuse, which is why idea 1's guard clause says the parts could refuse. Kropotkin refuses both the war of all against all and a nature that is "only harmony and peace" [[33]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-kropotkin-1918-neither-rousseau-nor-huxley): his mutual aid limits struggle but does not abolish it [[34]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-kropotkin-1918-harmony-within-communities) (his word is согласіе, concord).

## Tensions and critiques

- Chimera states show that synchronized and unsynchronized groups can coexist [[35]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-chimera-states). This supports the idea, but don't push the analogy to societies too hard.
- **The rival definition: likeness is the ideal.** Mersenne, running coincidence theory to its end, makes the unison the sweetest consonance and the "exemplary cause and end" of all others [[36]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-mersenne-unison-sweetest). Dong Zhongshu's resonance is like following like [[37]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-dong-zhongshu-like-follows-like) (partial), and Xunzi's music "unites the same" and makes "none fail to obey" [[38]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-xunzi-music-unites-same-ritual-separates), [[39]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-asian-xunzi-he-as-uniformity). Idea 1 names Mersenne and Dong as the rival and rejects them by this page's argument; the page must therefore show, not assume, that likeness under coupling ends in lock.
- **"Resolved, not kept."** Several of idea 1's best witnesses end in the lock pole and call it harmony. Theon's Pythagoreans bring the differently minded to like-mindedness [[40]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-theon-unification-of-the-many). Eriugena gathers the dissonant parts into one concord [[41]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-eriugena-dissonant-parts-consonant-whole) and finds the whipped slave inside "one harmony of the universe" [[42]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#anc-eriugena-royal-house-harmony). Laozi's 和光同塵 is a path to 玄同, "mysterious sameness", with no self and no things [[43]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-laozi-ch56-xuantong-no-self-no-things). Hu Zhen's 和 sees the ten thousand things as one body [[44]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-huzhen-he-sees-all-as-one-body) (partial). The Upanishads value unity reached as the parts' distinctness disappears [[45]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-asian-upanishad-unity-erases-parts). For these traditions lock is the goal, not the failure. The thesis is a claim *against* them, not a summary of them.
- **Cusanus is on both sides.** He keeps a singularity in every thing [[46]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#mus-cusa-singularity-harmony-in-diversity), but the variety he keeps is of rites around one faith [[47]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-cusa-una-religio-in-rituum-varietate).
- **The Vinaya is mixed.** The same commentary that reads water-and-milk as tolerance defines discord as "not one" in views [[31]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-vinaya-commentary-water-milk-is-tolerance), so difference of view beyond the Buddha's teaching counts as schism.
- **The 和/同 distinction did not stop misuse.** It was still used to demand conformity [[48]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-asian-he-tong-conformity) (partial). A named distinction is not a guard.

## Open questions

- Can "distance from lock" be measured as a general quantity, for example detuning relative to the width of the locking region?
- The prediction in [unverified] could fail: does like-only coupling lower diversity monotonically, while coupling through shared partials keeps several ratios alive? A simulation would settle it for oscillators.
- Is the Byzantine "without confusion" (Pachymeres, Dionysius) the same distinction as the Chinese 同而異, or only a parallel? An independent origin would count toward "found in several traditions" (idea 1); a shared one would not.
- Where does social lock begin? Spinoza's fear and flattery mark the end; is there an observable sign (loss of dissent, loss of trust) before it?

## What changed (2026-10-24)

1. **A historical lineage.** Aristotle, Yanzi, Gregory of Nyssa, Metochites, Pachymeres, the Chinese commentators and a Tibetan commentary all say that unison or fusion is the failure of concord. All are verified except the four commentators (partial).
2. **A rival lineage, made explicit.** Mersenne, Dong Zhongshu and Xunzi make likeness the ideal; Theon, Eriugena, Laozi's 玄同, Hu Zhen and the Upanishads treat resolution into one as harmony. The thesis now reads as one side of a dispute.
3. **Social lock.** Spinoza's concord by fear and flattery gives the page a social case and links it to idea 1's "could refuse".
4. **Cusanus on the near-miss.** Exact proportion is impossible for sensible things: the near-miss is the only harmony there is, not a flaw in it.
5. **The mechanism proposal** [unverified] gives this page a testable prediction from idea 12.

title: 3. Harmony is hierarchical: levels of wholeness
md:
**Clarified idea.** Harmony is nested: note, chord, song, album, culture; or self, family, state, nature. Each level is a whole made of the level below it. Two consequences follow:

- **What is dissonant at one level can be harmonious at the next**, so judging harmony means first saying which level you are judging [[1]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/proposals#prop-level-relative-resolution). It counts as harmonious at the next level only if the dissonant part shares in the resolution; otherwise it is a whole bought with a part (ideas/01).
- **The hierarchy persists when coupling is strong within each level and weak between levels**, with the levels running at different speeds [[2]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/proposals#prop-hierarchy-weak-coupling-between-levels).



## Grounding

- Simon: nearly decomposable systems. Components act roughly independently in the short run and depend on one another only in aggregate over the long run [[3]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-simon-near-decomposability), [[4]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-near-decomposability).
- Confucian nested levels (individual, interpersonal, societal, natural) [[5]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/lomas#lomas-nested-levels).
- In tonal harmony, a chord is harmonious for where the piece is going [[6]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-tonal-harmony-is-motion); tension builds and resolves over time [[7]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-lerdahl-tension).
- Nested brain rhythms and communication through coherence [[8]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/neuro#neuro-ctc-fries).

**Dissonant in the part, consonant in the whole: the tradition states the first consequence outright.**

- Plotinus: "the tune a soul sings discordant to itself is melodious to the whole"; the whole is beautiful when each part gives its own tone, even a lesser one [[9]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-plotinus-whole-harmony-unequal-voices). Augustine's world-poem is composed of antitheses [[10]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-augustine-world-poem-antitheses). Eriugena: what seems "mutually dissonant" in the parts is "fitting and consonant" in the most general harmony [[11]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-eriugena-dissonant-parts-consonant-whole). Wolff gives the same thing as a rule of perfection: a composite can contain what would be an imperfection in a part taken alone [[12]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-wolff-part-imperfection-belongs-to-whole).
- Music makes it technical. Rameau's dissonant chords must follow one another in a chain until the leading note settles the conclusion [[13]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-rameau-dissonance-chain); Tartini calls a well-placed chord of the ninth or eleventh "in its own way a unity" [[14]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-tartini-dissonance-is-unity). In India the vādī/samvādī/vivādī roles are defined relative to the focal note of a given melody, not between pitches in the abstract [[15]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-natyashastra-samvadi-nine-thirteen), [[16]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-sangitaratnakara-vadi-king-vivadi-enemy). Zeami judges harmony over the whole day's programme (jo-ha-kyū), not the single piece [[17]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-zeami-jo-ha-kyu-program).

**One harmony named at many levels.** The commonest pre-modern form is a ladder on which one ratio or one word recurs:

- Boethius's three musics, cosmic, human and instrumental [[18]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-boethius-three-musics); Macrobius's soul gathering a faculty at each sphere on the way down [[19]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-macrobius-descent-gathers-faculties), and the Hermetic soul giving one back at each zone on the way up [[20]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-hermetica-ascent-gives-back-harmony).
- Pico's three worlds are one world bound by a "discordant concord", each keeping "its own seat and laws" [[21]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-pico-worlds-discordant-concord); Giorgi's man is the bond who holds every level in one consonance [[22]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-giorgi-man-bond-one-consonance).
- China: Zhongyong ch. 1 runs zhonghe from one person's feelings to heaven and earth taking their places [[23]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-zhongyong-zhonghe-cosmic-order); the Yueji's pair (music unites, ceremony distinguishes) runs from cosmos to state to mind [[24]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-yueji-music-unites-ceremony-distinguishes). Laozi uses 和 for notes (ch. 2, in Legge's translation), the cosmos's breath (ch. 42) and the infant's body (ch. 55) [[25]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-laozi-ch2-notes-harmonious-through-relation), [[26]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-laozi-ch42-harmonised-by-breath), [[27]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-laozi-ch55-harmony-of-the-infant); ch. 18 adds the family, where harmony is the unmarked state and the named virtues appear only when it fails [[28]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-laozi-ch18-six-kin-not-in-harmony).
- Byzantium ranks the levels. Dionysius' "harmony and order" of the hierarchies is, in Pachymeres, the work of a ἁρμοστής who fits each member, and God is "super-essential self-harmony" [[29]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-pachymeres-god-as-self-harmony). Metochites: no harmony of association "unless it is divided ... in appropriate grades" [[30]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-metochites-no-harmony-without-grades).

**Later and modern.** Humboldt defines nature as "unity in multiplicity" and the scientist's task as resolving diversity into unity, one picture from nebulae to organisms [[31]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-humboldt-1845-unity-in-multiplicity), [[32]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-humboldt-1845-diversity-resolved-into-unity). Fechner's principle of unity through the manifold has a middle optimum between monotony and fragmentation [[33]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-fechner-unity-through-manifold), [[34]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/art#art-fechner-monotony-or-fragmentation); his author page reads it as "higher relations of unity" letting diversity grow, a phrase not yet in any claim (unverified). His psychophysics is literally nested waves: a main wave crossing a threshold with smaller upper waves riding on it [[35]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#sci-fechner-wave-scheme-threshold). Wallace places the organism inside "the grand march of nature" [[36]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-wallace-butterfly-wing-part-of-whole) and defines health as harmony between the individual and the universe [[37]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-wallace-1864-harmony-individual-universe), but he holds that the sense of harmony itself, at the level of mind, lies outside selection [[38]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ecology#eco-wallace-1869-harmony-beyond-selection): organism, world and mind as three levels he does not join by one mechanism.

## For alignment

**Sycophancy is note-level harmony that loses the album.** A reply that pleases now but erodes someone's judgment over a year is consonant locally and disharmonious overall. Evaluations should therefore be long-horizon, not single-turn.

Two ways the hierarchy can collapse:

- one fast level, such as an AI feedback loop, sets the pace for every slower one;
- one level absorbs the others, producing global sameness.

## Tensions and critiques

- **Level-relativity is the classic theodicy.** Plotinus's discordant soul is in "darkness, and in Tartarus" [[9]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-plotinus-whole-harmony-unequal-voices); Augustine's antitheses include the wicked [[10]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-augustine-world-poem-antitheses); Eriugena's dissonance-in-the-part "licenses dismissing any part's complaint as a view from too low" [[11]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-eriugena-dissonant-parts-consonant-whole). Campanella takes the last step: parts die "serving its great life" [[39]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-campanella-parts-die-for-whole). The first consequence of this page, unguarded, is exactly the sacrifice that ideas/01's guard clause forbids [[40]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-harmony-as-power). Rameau marks the safer version: dissonance carries the progression forward and is then resolved *for the hearer of the same piece* [[13]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-rameau-dissonance-chain). The test that separates the two: does the dissonant part itself reach the resolution, or only the whole?
- **The correspondence traditions deny weak coupling.** For al-Kindī every thing, however small, is "a state of the whole celestial harmony", so one individual fully known would show the whole "as if through a mirror" [[41]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-kindi-thing-mirror-of-harmony). Postel's whole is "wholly in each part" [[42]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-postel-quaternary-harmony-whole-in-each). These are strongly coupled, holographic hierarchies, and they are what make astrology and magic seem possible. They contradict the second consequence head on; they also suggest why it matters, since their strong coupling yields one pattern copied at every level rather than a new kind of whole at each.
- **Ranked levels, not mutually strengthening ones.** In Analects I.12, the source of Shōtoku's Article 1, he is subordinate to li [[43]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-shotoku-art1-from-analects); Shōtoku grounds obedience in Heaven over Earth [[44]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-shotoku-art3-lord-heaven-vassal-earth). Al-Fārābī's city has limbs that "only serve" [[45]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-farabi-city-as-body); Ibn Khaldun's whole needs one element to predominate [[46]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/social#soc-khaldun-asabiyya-like-temperament); the Gita assigns each varna its duty [[47]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-gita-svadharma-rank). ideas/01 allows rank; these texts test whether the lower level gains anything from the higher.
- **The Vinaya puts the level problem inside the community.** The sangha's concord is "one recitation", "like water and milk" [[48]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-vinaya-harmonious-community-water-milk). One commentator reads the simile as mutual tolerance of speech, not identity of persons, yet makes the Buddha's teaching the standard, so difference of view beyond it counts as discord [[49]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/asian#asian-tib-vinaya-commentary-water-milk-is-tolerance). Concord at the level of the rule, tolerance at the level of persons: two levels, and the upper one sets the limit of the lower.
- **Not every multi-level word is a harmony word.** Avicenna's balanced complexion is relative to each people and each person [[50]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-avicenna-complexion-relative), a levels picture of many local norms. The Gita's *sama* and the Ṛgveda's *ṛta* run across levels too, but as sameness and as one law (see authors/bhagavad-gita.md, authors/rgveda.md, lexicon). A ladder of levels supports this page only when each level is itself a whole of unlike parts.
- **Wallace is not a holist about diversity.** His whole is kept by selection and equilibrium, never valued for its parts' diversity [[51]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-wallace-harmony-is-fit-not-diversity) (partial).

## Open questions

- How should harmony be weighted across levels? Which level is the "album" for a human–AI relationship?
- What distinguishes an acceptable level-relative dissonance (the suspension that resolves) from a theodicy (the soul left in Tartarus)? Candidate test: the dissonant part must itself share in the higher-level resolution, at some timescale it lives through.
- Is weak coupling a condition of *harmony* or only of a *hierarchy of different kinds*? The holographic schemes (al-Kindī, Postel) are strongly coupled and still called harmony. A model could test whether strong inter-level coupling collapses the levels into one repeated pattern, as idea 2's lock predicts [[52]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-strong-coupling-unison), [[53]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/proposals#prop-coupling-window).
- Does any ranked tradition (Metochites, al-Fārābī, Shōtoku) show the lower level *strengthened* by the higher, or only ordered by it?

## What changed (2026-10-24)

- Grounding for "dissonant at one level, harmonious at the next" now runs from Plotinus, Augustine and Eriugena through Rameau, Tartini and the Indian vādī system, not only modern tonal theory.
- That same consequence is now flagged as the theodicy pattern (Plotinus, Augustine, Eriugena, Campanella): the page's first thesis is the one most in need of ideas/01's guard clause.
- Counter-evidence for weak coupling: al-Kindī's and Postel's holographic hierarchies, where every part mirrors the whole.
- Ranked hierarchies (Pachymeres, Metochites, al-Fārābī, Shōtoku, Ibn Khaldun) and the Vinaya's rule-versus-persons concord added as tests of whether levels strengthen each other.
- Humboldt, Fechner and Wallace give the 19th-century scientific versions: unity in multiplicity, nested waves, organism in world.

title: 4. Number holds two harmonies, and the cosmos expresses both
md:
**Clarified idea.** The Pythagorean argument runs: the cosmos is ordered by number, number gives the ratios by which unlike things are fitted, and harmony is what the fitted parts then do, so harmony appears throughout the cosmos, and music is one place it shows. The argument holds once two corrections are made.

1. **Number has two harmonies.** Commensurable ratios *lock* coupled systems that lose energy; this is the source of consonance, fusion and entrainment. Maximally incommensurable ratios *survive* in systems that conserve energy; this is the source of robustness and freedom from interference. Both belong to the whole [[1]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/proposals#prop-two-harmonies-of-number).
2. **Number also contains disorder.** Which harmony a given system shows is an empirical question.

## Grounding

- The Pythagorean thesis as Aristotle reports it: "the whole heaven was a harmony and a number" [[2]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-aristotle-heaven-harmony-number). Philolaus: knowable things "have a number" [[3]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-philolaus-number-knowable). His principles were limit and unlimited [[4]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-philolaus-octave-remainder).
- **The world-soul is built from harmonic ratios** [[5]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-timaeus-world-soul-ratios), [[6]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-taylor-timaeus-soul-numbers). Archytas' three means (arithmetic, geometric, harmonic) [[7]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-archytas-three-means). Boethius' three kinds of music: of the cosmos, of the human being, of instruments [[8]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-boethius-three-musics).
- **Harmony as a ratio of unlike things, in the definitions.** The Suda defines ἁρμονία as the proportion (συμμετρία) of high and low [[9]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-suda-voice-rhythm-harmony-diction), and as the union of things "of different mind" [[10]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-suda-harmony-union-of-the-differently-minded). Ficino: the harmonic ratio, not the arithmetic or geometric, is the bond that makes unlike things like and joins unequal things in a shared equality [[11]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#fic-timaeus-harmonic-ratio-likens-unlike), which is why the world-soul is built from it [[12]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#fic-timaeus-celestial-soul-harmony-passes-into-world).
- **The Byzantine harmonics keep both number and the ear.** Psellos: the soul holds a "harmonized multitude", neither bare unlimited mass nor multitude alone [[13]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-psellos-harmonized-multitude), with Harmony one of three parts of its essence [[14]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-psellos-soul-harmony-and-not). That is Philolaus' limit and unlimited, read in the eleventh century. Bryennius keeps Ptolemy's division: the ear checks coarse differences, reason shows the smallest [[15]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-bryennius-reason-shows-what-hearing-cannot) (partial). Pachymeres reads Dionysius' blending as a co-breathing that leads opposites to harmony without destroying their natures [[16]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-pachymeres-opposites-led-to-harmony-by-simple-elements).
- **Vitruvius builds with the concords.** He lists six concords (symphoniae) from the fourth to the double octave [[17]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-vitruvius-six-concords-after-tetrachords) and sets bronze vessels tuned to the tetrachord among the theatre seats, so the voice from the stage strikes them in concord [[18]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-vitruvius-theatre-vessels-concordant-harmony). Eurythmy and symmetry carry the ratios into architecture [[19]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-vitruvius-eurythmy-symmetry-defined), [[20]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-vitruvius-temple-symmetry-from-human-body).
- **Mathematics fixes the order, not the material.** Feigenbaum universality [[21]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-feigenbaum-universality); Kac's drum [[22]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-kac-drum); Wigner's "unreasonable effectiveness" [[23]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-wigner).
- **Commensurability locks.** Arnold tongues [[24]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-mode-locking-arnold); Huygens' clocks [[25]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-huygens-sympathy-of-clocks); the Kuramoto model [[26]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-kuramoto-model); the TRAPPIST-1 resonant chain [[27]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-trappist1-resonant-chain).
- **Lipps returns harmony to number, against Helmholtz.** Lipps (1905) says he defends "the oldest theory": simple and less simple vibration ratios are responsible for all consonance and dissonance [[28]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-lipps-1905-thesis-ratio-theory-defended), and argues that dissonance cannot consist in beats, because then hearing a dissonance would be hearing beats [[29]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-lipps-1905-dissonance-not-awareness-of-beats). Against Helmholtz's beats account [[30]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-helmholtz-beats), he puts the ratios of tone-rhythms: these make harmony and disharmony, and ratios near the simple ones act nearly like them [[31]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-lipps-1885-rhythm-ratios-make-harmony); rhythms that cross decidedly enough make disharmony [[32]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-lipps-1885-crossing-rhythms-make-disharmony); a single sound is one ground-rhythm differentiated [[33]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-lipps-1905-one-ground-rhythm-differentiated). This is the lock side of the page stated as perception: commensurable rhythms fuse, crossing ones do not. The "nearly like the simple ones" clause is the tolerance that makes temperament work.
- **Incommensurability survives.** KAM tori [[34]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-kam-irrational-survive) (partial). Klimesch argues the golden mean separates brain frequencies [[35]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/neuro#neuro-brain-octave-architecture) (low confidence).
- **The remainder is real arithmetic.** The comma [[36]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-pythagorean-comma); why twelve notes [[37]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-why-twelve); equal temperament tunes in an irrational ratio, 2^(1/12) [[38]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-equal-temperament-irrational).

- **The remainder, read by the author studies.**
  - Cusanus: precise equality belongs to God alone, so no two voices or bells are ever in exact ratio [[39]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-cusa-no-precise-harmony-in-sensibles). The remainder is a property of the sensible world, not a defect of one tuning.
  - Salinas sets the "perfect" just instrument beside the "imperfect" tempered one and ranks them [[40]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-salinas-aristoxenus-closer-than-pythagoreans), [[41]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-salinas-viols-twelve-equal-semitones). That is this page's two harmonies, held together but ranked.
  - Tartini praises Vallotti's unequal temperament for its "chiaro oscuro": the imperfection is placed, not hidden [[42]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-tartini-vallotti-chiaroscuro).
- **Hegel's nodal line.** In the Logic's account of measure, tones moving step by step from the fundamental reach, at certain points, a new harmonic relation: a qualitative node on a quantitative line [[43]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#phil-hegel-nodal-line-harmonic-return). That is a third way to read the two harmonies. The commensurable ratios are nodes on a continuum, and between the nodes the line goes on. Hegel's word for harmony there is the node, not diversity, so he supports this page and not idea 1. His *Ästhetik* (music chapter) is imported and queued for translation; read it before going further.

## Tensions and critiques

- **Schopenhauer reads the same arithmetic the other way.** A pure harmonic system is "sogar schon arithmetisch unmöglich", and music can only hide its essential dissonances by temperament, which mirrors a world that is "a constant battlefield" [[44]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-schopenhauer-pure-system-impossible). This page reads the comma as a second harmony that survives; Schopenhauer reads it as cosmic self-conflict. The KB should hold both readings and say which one a paper adopts.

- **Number or beats?** Lipps and Helmholtz explain the same consonances by different mechanisms: ratio (rhythm) against roughness (beats). The modern synthesis gives each school part of the truth: number explains which intervals fuse, the ear's additive space and tolerance explain how we move between them, and liking is learned [[45]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-ratio-vs-ear-verdict-split). Lipps also concedes that taste in consonance differs with each person's "Resonanz" [[46]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-lipps-1905-resonanz-of-the-pleasant). So the page can claim number for the *criterion*, not for the preference.
- **Harmony follows the parts.** The Suda (from Philoponus): harmony "comes to" things already fitted and follows them, so the strings must exist and be tightened first [[47]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-suda-harmony-follows-the-fitted). On this reading number does not *contain* harmony; harmony is what arises when fitted parts sound together. That is a correction to the order of the Pythagorean argument, not to its conclusion.
- **A small-number ratio is one rule among others.** Wolff's doorway: one rule wants height to width in small numbers, another wants the door wide enough for loaded carts, and they can clash [[48]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/philsci#phil-wolff-door-ratio-vs-passage). Commensurability yields to function, which fits this page's "which harmony a system shows is an empirical question".
- **Word caution.** In Vitruvius V.4 "harmonia" names the enharmonic genus, not concord in general [[17]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-vitruvius-six-concords-after-tetrachords). That he follows Aristoxenus is unverified [unverified].
- Fitting the world to the number: the counter-earth [[49]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-aristotle-counter-earth).
- The selection effect: we notice the harmonious cases [[50]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-selection-effect). One reply is that dissonance and irrationals are part of the whole.
- "All is number" is Aristotle's gloss [[51]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-all-is-number-aristotles-gloss).
- Beauty can mislead physics [[52]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-beauty-misleads-physics).
- Golden-ratio overclaims [unverified].

## Open questions

- Is there a single mathematical account in which rational lock and irrational survival are two regimes of one principle? Philolaus' limit and unlimited, formalized.

- Lipps' "ratios differing from simple ones by few elements act nearly like the simple ones": is that the same tolerance as the Arnold-tongue width around a rational ratio? If so, Lipps' perceptual claim and the mode-locking physics are one account.

## What changed (2026-10-24)

- Added Lipps (1885, 1905) as the modern defender of the ratio theory against Helmholtz's beats, and the modern synthesis that splits the question between number and ear.
- Added the definitions (the Suda; Ficino on the harmonic ratio), the Byzantine harmonics (Psellos' harmonized multitude, Bryennius, Pachymeres) and Vitruvius' concords and theatre vessels.
- Added three tensions: number or beats, harmony follows the fitted parts (Suda), and Wolff's doorway, where the small-number ratio yields to use.
- 23 claims were folded in, including Byzantine and Lipps claims the list did not carry. Laozi and most of Wolff arrive through author pages and bear on ideas 01 and 05 more than here.

title: 5. Ratios are one manifestation: five phenomena behind the word "harmony"
md:
**Clarified idea.** The single word covers five different phenomena. Keeping them apart stops "harmony" from meaning everything:

1. **Modes (harmonics).** The frequencies a body can vibrate at, set by its shape.
2. **Resonance.** Energy flowing into a body when a drive matches one of its modes. Resonance responds to matching only, and carries a Q trade-off between sharp response and long ringing.
3. **Locking.** Nonlinear oscillators adjusting each other until they settle into simple ratios.
4. **Consonance.** A listener's perception of sounds as smooth or fused.
5. **Tonal harmony.** A grammar of tension and resolution over time.

Small whole-number ratios have **two independent physical origins**: the boundary modes of strings and pipes, and nonlinear locking. Integer spectra belong to the lyre, not to vibration in general.

## Grounding

- **Modes:** [disputed]. Most bodies are inharmonic [[1]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-inharmonic-bodies). Rameau's *corps sonore* "carries with it the same harmony that it makes resonate" [[2]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-rameau-corps-sonore). Sauveur named harmonics [[3]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-sauveur-harmonics).
- **Resonance:** the Q trade-off [[4]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-resonance-q-tradeoff) and phase [[5]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-resonance-phase). Lomas et al.'s definitions [[6]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/lomas#lomas-resonance-definitions).
- **Where resonance and consonance meet:** consonant intervals share partials, so they resonate sympathetically [[7]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-consonance-is-shared-partials). Galileo on strings answering at the unison, octave and fifth [[8]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-galileo-sympathetic-strings). Early modern sympathetic-resonance experiments [[9]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-sympathetic-resonance-early-modern).
- **Locking:** [[10]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-mode-locking-arnold), [[11]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/physics#phys-strong-coupling-unison).
- **Consonance:**
  - roughness [[12]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-roughness-plomp-levelt), [[13]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-helmholtz-beats);
  - harmonicity [[14]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-harmonicity-predicts);
  - virtual pitch [[15]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-terhardt-virtual-pitch);
  - timbre-matched scales [[16]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-sethares-timbre-scale);
  - composite models [[17]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-harrison-pearce-composite);
  - Euler's index of "sweetness" [[18]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-euler-gradus).
- **Tonal harmony:** [[19]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-tonal-harmony-is-motion), [[20]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-rameau-fundamental-bass), [[21]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-krumhansl-tonal-hierarchy), [[22]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-huron-itpra).

## The ear against the ratio: who was right

The oldest quarrel in harmonics is between the ratio school (Archytas, Euclid, the Pythagoreans) and Aristoxenus, who judged by the ear. Read in the texts, each school was right about a different one of the five phenomena [[23]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-ratio-vs-ear-verdict-split).

- **The ratio school had consonance's criterion.** Euclid defines consonant sounds as those that make "a single blending" (μίαν κρᾶσιν) [[24]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-euclid-consonance-single-blending), and Archytas's followers say the ear hears one sound [[25]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-archytas-followers-single-sound). That is fusion, which is the cross-culturally robust part of consonance [[26]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-fusion-universal). They also had the exactness: the comma is audible as beating.
- **Aristoxenus had the space and the function.** Intervals add, and his additive scale is twelve-tone equal temperament within 2 cents [[27]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#mus-aristoxenus-scale-is-twelve-tet). Consonances are fixed while dissonances have a range [[28]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#anc-aristoxenus-consonances-fixed-dissonances-loose); hearing judges size, the intellect function [[29]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-aristoxenus-ear-and-intellect). That is tonal harmony (5), not consonance (4).
- **His own ear test refutes him.** Building ditones by consonance inside a fourth, as he prescribes, falls a Pythagorean comma short, beating about 9 Hz at A3 [[30]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/music#anc-aristoxenus-fourth-ear-test), [[31]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-aristoxenus-fourth-test-misses-comma). The ear, used his way, sides with Euclid [[32]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-euclid-fourth-less-than-two-and-half-tones).
- **Ptolemy splits the work.** Hearing finds the approximately right, reason the exact [[33]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-ptolemy-hearing-and-reason-criteria); both schools erred [[34]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-ptolemy-both-schools-erred); the fault is "neither of reason nor of sense" [[35]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-ptolemy-neither-reason-nor-sense-at-fault). That is the modern synthesis, with one correction: the exactness is itself heard.
- **Liking is learned**, which neither school foresaw [[36]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-mus-no-universal-preference). Pseudo-Plutarch comes close: listeners who stopped using the enharmonic cannot perceive its quarter-tones [[37]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/ancient#anc-pseudo-plutarch-sense-and-intellect-run-together).
- **A warning for formula-makers.** Salinas prescribes twelve equal semitones for viols and then gives a golden-section construction that cannot produce them [[38]](/explore/histories/harmony/claims/critique#crit-salinas-golden-section-frets).
